column1: # Escaping references of the Web IDL census: authored input (ruling R-P6).
# Two tab-separated fields: <row id> <comma-separated identities, or ->, in
# the format census/url/dependencies.tsv established. Exactly one line per
# census row; every identity must resolve to a row of this census, to a row of
# generated/infra-census.tsv (the first cross-census join in this repository),
# or to an identity declared in census/webidl/externals.tsv. A duplicate line,
# a self dependency, an unknown row and an undeclared identity each fail
# generation, and an entry in externals.tsv that no line here uses fails too.
# Each line was derived from the [=…=], [$…$], {{…}} and [[…]] references
# inside that row's own byte span in the pinned index.bs, with whitespace
# normalised inside an autolink (Bikeshed wraps them across lines) and the
# display-text form split on "|". Recording a dependency is not a proof edge:
# it says the row's text reaches that identity, nothing about its meaning.
# Two references found in scope are deliberately not recorded. The Bikeshed
# bibliography citations [[DOM]] and [[INDEXEDDB]] are not internal slots, the
# same distinction Gates/Census.lean draws for [[FETCH]] in the Streams
# source. And {{WritableStreamDefaultWriter/closed}}, in the note beside "mark
# a promise as handled", is a back-reference into Streams that survey section 5
# group G rules out of the record: recording it would invert the layering
